import sys

def solve():
    N = int(input())
    cards = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    dp = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    
    for i in range(N):
        dp[i][i] = cards[i]
    
    for length in range(2, N + 1):
        for i in range(N - length + 1):
            j = i + length - 1
            dp[i][j] = max(cards[i] - dp[i+1][j], cards[j] - dp[i][j-1])
    
    result = (sum(cards) + dp[0][N-1]) // 2 - (sum(cards) - dp[0][N-1]) // 2
    print(result)

solve()
